MDG.note: Only a general aim to ease identity and civil register management; no records passing stated.
Number is given at enrolment, not at birth.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Interior and Decentralisation launched mass biometric enrolment (Izaho tokana 2.0) on 16 September, to record biometric data and give each person a unique identification number, financed by the World Bank through the DECIM project.
